exposure: Time interval between HIFU ablation and suction curettage (24-48 hours vs. within 6 hours)
cohort: The study included 115 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP).
finding: Suction curettage performed within 6 hours after HIFU ablation resulted in shorter hospitalization times compared to suction curettage performed 24-48 hours after the ablation, with similar efficacy and safety outcomes.
